examples.solution_text:
Take the reciprocal: swap the numerator and denominator.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\left(\frac{4}{7}\right)^{-1}\\&=\frac{7}{4}\end{aligned}$

Invert the whole fraction, including its coefficients.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\left(\frac{3a}{5b}\right)^{-1}\\&=\frac{5b}{3a}\end{aligned}$

Invert first, then square the numerator and denominator.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\left(\frac{3}{7}\right)^{-2}\\&=\left(\frac{7}{3}\right)^2\\&=\frac{49}{9}\end{aligned}$

Invert first. Apply the power to every factor, multiplying the indices of powers inside the brackets.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\left(\frac{3x^2}{4y}\right)^{-3}\\&=\left(\frac{4y}{3x^2}\right)^3\\&=\frac{4^3y^3}{3^3x^{2\times3}}\\&=\frac{64y^3}{27x^6}\end{aligned}$

Simplify inside the brackets, then invert and square.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\left(\frac{8m^2n}{12mn^3}\right)^{-2}\\&=\left(\frac{2m}{3n^2}\right)^{-2}\\&=\left(\frac{3n^2}{2m}\right)^2\\&=\frac{9n^4}{4m^2}\end{aligned}$

Simplify the negative power first, then multiply and cancel common factors.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\left(\frac{4a}{b^2}\right)^{-2}\times\frac{8a^3}{b}\\&=\left(\frac{b^2}{4a}\right)^2\times\frac{8a^3}{b}\\&=\frac{b^4}{16a^2}\times\frac{8a^3}{b}\\&=\frac{8a^3b^4}{16a^2b}\\&=\frac{ab^3}{2}\end{aligned}$

Simplify each negative power. To divide by a fraction, multiply by its reciprocal.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\left(\frac{x^2}{4y}\right)^{-2}\div\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)^{-3}\\&=\left(\frac{4y}{x^2}\right)^2\div\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)^3\\&=\frac{16y^2}{x^4}\div\frac{y^3}{x^3}\\&=\frac{16y^2}{x^4}\times\frac{x^3}{y^3}\\&=\frac{16x^3y^2}{x^4y^3}\\&=\frac{16}{xy}\end{aligned}$

Invert the fraction. A negative power in the denominator then moves to the numerator with a positive index.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\left(\frac{a^{-4}}{b^2}\right)^{-3}\\&=\left(\frac{b^2}{a^{-4}}\right)^3\\&=\left(a^4b^2\right)^3\\&=a^{12}b^6\end{aligned}$

examples.derivation: Inverting the entire fraction gives (3a/(5b))^(-1) = 5b/(3a), valid for non-zero a and b.
Inverting and cubing gives (4y/(3x^2))^3 = 4^3 y^3/(3^3 x^6) = 64y^3/(27x^6).
Inside the brackets, 8m^2n/(12mn^3) = 2m/(3n^2). Its reciprocal squared is (3n^2/(2m))^2 = 9n^4/(4m^2).
The bracket becomes b^4/(16a^2). Multiplication gives 8a^3b^4/(16a^2b) = ab^3/2.
The powers simplify to 16y^2/x^4 and y^3/x^3. Dividing gives (16y^2/x^4)(x^3/y^3) = 16/(xy).
